captures.description: ITHACA, BY THE OPERATOR'S ADDRESS 'ITHACA DEEPMIND', ON GOOGLE'S AI OVERVIEW, SIGNED OUT, 2026-10-31: 'a deep neural network developed by Google DeepMind and academic partners to restore, geographically attribute, and chronologically date damaged ancient Greek inscriptions.' Capabilities with their figures, architecture, the PHI training data, the Apache-2.0 code, the Predicting the Past interface, an offer on Aeneas. Four cards: DeepMind, GitHub, Predicting the Past, Nature.
